paragraphs: Yosef ben Elem, who served as High Priest, is mentioned in [Bavli Yoma 12b](https://www.sefaria.org/Yoma.12b.13). Hyman gives only Ben Elem for the passage near the end of [Jerusalem Talmud Horayot](https://www.sefaria.org/Jerusalem_Talmud_Horayot.3.2.30), and Ben Ilim for [Jerusalem Talmud Yoma 1:1](https://www.sefaria.org/Jerusalem_Talmud_Yoma.1.1.22).[^1][^2]

notes.text: The extra ד in Hyman’s Yerushalmi Yoma locator remains unexplained. The linked Yoma and Horayot passages use the modern section and paragraph numbers.

The two linked Yerushalmi passages use בן אלם and בן אילם, respectively. Hyman gives בן אילם in his longer entry. [Bavli Horayot](https://www.sefaria.org/Horayot.12b.2) uses בן אילים. See also [Heilprin’s comparison](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=1999&lang=en).
